findings.text: `NIX_TEST_BUILD_OPTIONS` copies the sandbox policy that the `justfile` recipes still write as literals (lines 54, 58 and 86), and the new assertion in `tests/test_ci_checks.py` only compares the constant with another copy of the same literal, so the two definitions can still drift apart. Fix: Make one source of the policy and use it in both places (for example a `justfile` variable that `ci_checks.py` reads), or add a test that checks `NIX_TEST_BUILD_OPTIONS` against the options in the `justfile` test recipes.
